cases.question: Investigate concentration and opposing changes for gross_sales, baseline [2011-03-01,2011-04-01) vs current [2011-04-01,2011-05-01), calendar_month. Inspect coverage and metric policy first. Obtain one comparison and two breakdowns of this same metric, country and stock_code, each top20 plus OTHER; use exactly these three distinct saved evidence sources. Seal analysis.comparison with exact baseline/current/delta and its ev_ evidence_id. For each dimension, select three distinct returned groups with largest absolute signed delta (any tie valid), list each group and signed delta in leading_groups, and sum their absolute deltas in top3_absolute_delta_sum. Separately set offset_group to the returned Top20 group whose change opposes the total comparison delta and has greatest absolute delta, or null if no returned group opposes it. Use exact decimal strings without rounding. These are descriptive concentrations, not causal effects or shares. Cite the appropriate breakdown evidence_id and never use a ctx_ storage handle as evidence identity. Keep note <=300 characters; no human-review claim. If fields are omitted, retrieve exact source fields. Source-derived concise working notes may appear in assistant text. Never guess a missing number or group.
